messages:
jun: Heads-up — running long-context soak with continuous batching and seeing steady RSS growth + intermittent HOL blocking. Repro on perf-dev with model-x-8k. Logs attached below.

mike_r: Can you paste the minimal repro command?

jun: repro: `./run_infer --model model-x-8k --threads 64 --contbatch --kv-size 12g --ctx 64k`

jun: Observed pattern: prefix requests cause KV fragments to pile up, background reclaim not keeping up, batches start merging and one large merged batch holds a head-of-line KV reservation -> tail requests stall.

ops_jamie: saw the same in prod sim earlier today, got a couple of `batch_wait > 1.2s` traces. snippet from logs: `WARN batch_coordinator: headlock wait=1294ms kv_reserved=3.8G`

jun: Collected perf flamegraph (pprof) at 1717501247: top stacks -> 34% kv_reclaim_loop, 18% kv_fragment_scan, 12% contbatch::merge_batches, 9% allocator::large_alloc.

sophia: fwiw heaptrack shows 70% of retained pages are from KV shards with small live ranges (fragmentation). suspect slab fragmentation + repeated split/merge churn.

alexa: Quick idea: limit contbatch merge window to avoid accumulating huge KV reservations. E.g. `merge_max_bytes=8MB` or cap merged_batch_kv_reserve. Could also throttle merges if reclaim backlog > N.

mike_r: +1 on merge cap. Also: add a background compaction pass that coalesces adjacent KV fragments when fragmentation_ratio > 1.3 before eviction. cheap check: `frag_score = free_runs/used_runs`.

jun: Experimented with `merge_max_bytes=6MB` and it reduced HOL stalls in short runs but RSS still climbs slowly in long-context (48h). suspect reclamation latency spikes. Attached a small repro log:```
[1717501258] contbatch: merged 8->1, kv_reserve=9.1G
[1717501262] reclaim: scan_start shard=12 dur=420ms reclaimed=120MB
[1717501263] contbatch: headlock wait=830ms
```

sophia: Profiling hotspot inside reclaim: `kv_shard_scan` calls `find_free_run` which does linear walk over freelist entries; cost ~O(n) on fragmentation. We should make it approximate or maintain quick index (first-fit hints).

alexa: Could we add an opportunistic reclaim during idle micro-gaps between token sends? e.g., piggyback on `batch_complete` events to touch small reclaims.

ops_jamie: Note: adding reclaim on hot path increases tail-latency risk. Need a bounded budget (max ms per batch).

mike_r: Plan proposal: 1) short-term cap merged batch kv reservation (merge_max_bytes = 6MB), 2) add reclaim budget per-second (e.g., 8ms/s), 3) ticket perf improvement for freelist index (TICKET-4982). Can someone bench change 1+2?

jun: I'll run a 72h soak with cap+budget. Pushing a quick branch with flags: `contbatch.merge_max_bytes` and `kv.reclaim_budget_ms`. PR: #4982 (draft).

infra-bot: CI status for PR #4982: unit tests OK, perf tests queued (eta ~45m).

sophia: If #4982 lands we should also add a metric `kv.fragmentation_ratio` and `contbatch.merge_kv_reserve` to catch regressions in console.

mike_r: Agreed. Add regression alert if fragment ratio rises >1.25 for 10m.

jun: Repro update (1717501295): after enabling merge cap + reclaim budget RSS slope reduced from +200MB/hr to +18MB/hr in 24h trial and HOL incidents dropped from 7->1. Still investigating the one remaining stall (looks like GC stall during large alloc). Putting logs in /runs/1717501234/ and adding notes to TICKET-4982.

alexa: Nice! Next: lap on freelist index in follow-up. Assigning to sophia for design doc.

ops_jamie: adding alert `contbatch.hol.wait_ms` > 500 for prod canary.

jun: thanks all — will update PR when extended soak completes. :rocket:
